subject: OmegaAI POC - Week 2 status & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma@omegaai.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@omegaai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OmegaAI discovery follow-up + proposed POC success criteria

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and excited about the possibility of running a short POC to validate cost and latency for your customer-facing summarization feature. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Summary of needs:
- Real-time summary generation from live customer support transcripts (avg. session length ~1200 tokens)
- Latency target: <= 350ms p95 for 512-token outputs
- Cost goal: < $0.002 per summary on average
- Data controls: logs retained 30 days, KMS for keys

Proposed POC plan (2 weeks):
1) Success criteria (draft): accurate summaries (ROUGE-L > 0.45 on our eval set), latency p95 <= 350ms, stable throughput of 50 reqs/min with <5% error rate.
2) Evaluation plan: provide 200 representative sessions + golden summaries. We'll run 500 sample requests through the POC environment and provide detailed latency/cost breakdowns.
3) Timeline: kickoff next Monday (8/10), 1 week ingestion & infra, 1 week evaluation and handoff.
4) Ownership: Emma/Liam to provide sample data and access; Redwood (Marissa + Dev) to provision POC environment; Marcus to monitor perf and Tuning.

Action items (to confirm):
- Emma: share the 200 session sample and the golden summaries by EOD Friday (8/7).
- Dev: confirm data access method (S3 vs secure upload) and required IAM roles.
- Marcus: confirm whether we need a dedicated GPU sandbox or if hosted shared infra will suffice for this load.

I've attached a short one-pager with the success criteria draft (omegaai_poc_success_criteria.docx) — please review and let me know edits. Once we have the sample data, I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff to align infra/credentials.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: omegaai_poc_success_criteria.docx (1 page)
From: Emma Zhao <emma@omegaai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@omegaai.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OmegaAI discovery follow-up + proposed POC success criteria

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligned with what we discussed. Couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: we can run ROUGE-L but would also like a quick human rating on coherence (1-5) for a 50-sample subset. Can Redwood include that as part of the eval?
- Data access: we can share the sessions via a pre-signed S3 link. We'll need a contact for the upload and a small checklist for the data schema (timestamps, speaker labels, golden summary).
- Timeline: 8/10 kickoff works. If we share data by EOD 8/7 we'll be ready.

We'll aim to have the sample set ready. I'll confirm with Liam on the human rating subset and upload details by EOD Friday.

Best,
Emma Zhao
Product Lead, OmegaAI
emma@omegaai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma@omegaai.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@omegaai.com>

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OmegaAI discovery follow-up + proposed POC success criteria

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Emma — yes we can include a light human rating for the 50-sample subset; we'll provide a simple form and one of our UX researchers will do the batch.

On data upload: Dev, can you confirm the exact S3 path and the minimal IAM role we should ask OmegaAI to create? If easier we can provide an upload endpoint with a short checklist.

Attached is an updated success criteria doc (omegaai_poc_success_criteria.docx) — small changes: added the human-rating plan and clarified the error-rate calc.

Kickoff: Monday 8/10 at 10:00am PT — holding a 30-min slot; will send calendar invite once we have confirmation.

Next steps (short):
- Emma/Liam: share S3 presigned link or create upload role by 8/7 EOD.
- Redwood: prepare POC environment (initial perf profile, 1 GPU sandbox) and eval harness.

Thanks — ping me if anything else.

Cheers,
Marissa

Attachment: omegaai_poc_success_criteria.docx (updated)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OmegaAI discovery follow-up + proposed POC success criteria

Looping in Marcus for infra sizing. Quick notes on the S3 upload and sandbox: 

- S3: presigned upload link is easiest for the customer; we can also accept a bucket with an upload role. If they want the role, we need arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/RedwoodPOCUploadRole with PutObject permissions to the provided prefix.
- Schema checklist: each session as JSONL with fields: session_id, timestamp_iso, speaker_role (agent/customer), transcript, golden_summary. If they include audio, we won't process audio in this POC.
- Sandbox: for the expected load (50 reqs/min, 512-token outputs), a single A100-equivalent GPU should be fine for the evaluation runs; reserve a dedicated GPU for the 2-week window to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

Action items for Redwood (internal):
- Marcus: please provision a dedicated A100 sandbox for 8/10-8/24 and confirm cost estimate.
- Marissa: once we have the upload link, I'll validate sample ingestion and run a quick smoke test.

I'll be available during the 8/10 kickoff to walk through env and data ingestion.

Thanks,
Dev
Staff Engineer, Redwald Inference (infra)
dev_patel@redwood.com
